name: Standard Chartered Simply Cash + Credit Card Funds Transfer
highlights: 0.6% Cashback with new Credit Card Funds Transfer applications
2% Cashback with min. of S$800 per month
Apply here to enjoy the convenience of a single application for a Standard Chartered Simply Cash Credit Card & a Credit Card Funds Transfer!
Standard Chartered Credit Card Funds Transfer benefits:
Get extra cash at 0% interest with loan tenures from 3 to 12 months
One-time low processing fee from 0.99% (EIR from 3.62%)
Enjoy flexible repayment, choose to pay minimum amount due or full outstanding amount
Instant cash disbursement to any bank account or other bank's credit card
Standard Chartered Simply Cash Credit Card benefits:
Flat 1.5% cashback rate for all eligible purchases
Enjoy dining and shopping discount privileges at over 3,000 outlets in Asia with Standard Chartered’s The Good Life Program
1 year annual fee waiver, no minimum spend required

citation.title: Standard Chartered Simply Cash + Credit Card Funds Transfer

extra.summary: The Standard Chartered Simply Cash + Credit Card Funds Transfer offers a limited time up to 2.6% unlimited cashback on most spending, making it ideal for those who dislike tracking bonus categories. The low processing fee and 0% interest Credit Card Funds Transfer is offers savings of up to 86% on interest charges as compared to other cards. Enjoy ease of application through this single flow journey which will enable you to get both the Simply Cash Credit Card as well as the Credit Card Funds Transfer!

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: S$50 OR 1% of principal / interest, fees & charges / overlimit amount / past due amount, whichever is higher

documents-required.SG Citizens or PRs:
Apply via MyInfo and prepare the following, 
1. Copy of Passport (6 months validity), and page with address displayed (where applicable), 
2. Copy of Employment Pass, 
3. Either one of the following: utility bill, tax bill, latest bank /credit card statement, rental agreement showing your address, latest mobile phone statement, letter from employer stating current address, government-issued document stating current address
